name: Tomb of Dong Khanh
kicker: A short stop beside Tu Duc’s tomb
summary: A small tomb beside Tu Duc’s, built around Ngưng Hy hall, the temple Đồng Khánh began for his father before he died at 25. Cross the court to the hall and the stair pavilions, then climb to the burial on Hộ Thuận Sơn just west of it. Add it when you are already at Tu Duc.
getThere: Beside Tu Duc’s tomb: thôn Thượng Hai, Thủy Xuân (also listed as Đoàn Nhữ Hải).
heroCaption: Ngưng Hy hall across the court at Dong Khanh’s tomb

notice.title: Single or paired with Tu Duc
notice.body: The single adult ticket is 100,000 VND. A ticket that pairs this tomb with Tu Duc is 200,000 VND for an adult. Neither is part of the four-site ticket.

body: The tomb sits beside Tu Duc’s, in Thượng Hai, Thủy Xuân. Tự Đức was Đồng Khánh’s uncle and adoptive father.

Đồng Khánh died at 25. The hall began as Truy Tư, the temple he started for his father in the second month of 1888, and it was renamed Ngưng Hy after he died. The burial is on Hộ Thuận Sơn, 30 metres west of the hall. Khải Định rebuilt the tomb buildings from August 1916, and the hall with its side houses continued to 1923.
An adult ticket is 100,000 VND, and children under 13 enter free. It is a short stop if you are already at Tu Duc.

gettingThere: Go upstream to Thủy Xuân by bicycle or taxi, the same trip as Tu Duc’s tomb. The two tombs are next to each other.

legs.heading: From the south bank
legs.body: Upstream to Thủy Xuân, beside Tu Duc.

hours: 16 Mar–15 Oct: 06:30–18:00, tickets until 17:30. 16 Oct–15 Mar: 07:00–17:30, tickets until 17:00 (conservation centre notice, 12 Mar 2024). Confirm the board on arrival.
closed: No weekly closing day on the centre’s notice.
admissionNote: Adult 100,000 VND. A child from 7 to 12 is free. Under 7 is free. Hue residents and the other groups named in Resolution 55 pay half. A pair with Tu Duc is 200,000 VND for an adult and 30,000 VND for a child from 7 to 12. That pair is not the single-tomb price, and it is not the four-site ticket.
